name: prb-persuasion-risk-benchmark
description: A dataset for evaluating models on detection and assessment of persuasive content that may pose risk; it labels texts for persuasive tactics and potential harms. The benchmark is intended to measure how well models identify risky persuasion strategies and thus supports research on model safety and mitigation. It is primarily framed as a classification benchmark for automated risk-detection systems.
reputation: Designed for safety evaluation of persuasive content and used in niche academic safety research, with limited mainstream adoption so far.
